about.eyebrow: Mechanical Engineering — Stevens Institute of Technology
about.bodyP1: I'm a mechanical engineering student at Stevens Institute of Technology, and most of what I know about design I learned by making the part first and drawing it second. I spend my week split between the machine shop and the CAD workstation — running mills and lathes on one side, modeling and tolerancing on the other — which is exactly the loop I want to keep running in aerospace: design something, understand how it's actually manufactured, and make it better because of that.
about.bodyP2: As President & Chief Engineer of Stevens' SAE BAJA Racing Team, I lead the design, manufacturing, and testing of a competition off-road vehicle end to end. As Head TA for a 200-level manufacturing course, I teach GD&T, CAM, and DFM to the next group of students coming through the shop I work in.
about.school: Stevens Institute of Technology, Hoboken NJ

bullets: Collaborate with faculty, PhD, and undergraduate researchers to fabricate precision parts for a supersonic wind tunnel, wave tank, high-speed imaging device, and a Navy scale boat.
Designed and manufactured a biomass 3D printer using SolidWorks, Fusion 360, mills, lathes, and additive manufacturing equipment.
Led the acquisition and campus-wide deployment of a $100,000 laser cutter for student engineering organizations.
Maintain shop facilities and hardware inventory, manage user access, and service 30+ 3D printers and laser cutting equipment.
Lead lectures and lab sessions for a 200-level engineering course covering GD&T, CAM, DFM, metrology, machining, cold forming, and welding.
Evaluate and grade student engineering drawings, CAD models, CAM toolpaths, machining operations, and final design projects.
Researched transverse wave behavior in metallic structures and designed a crystalline unit cell structure to produce roton behavior for experimental testing.
Assembled a surface-mount machine to automate fabrication of unit cell structures and presented findings at a university technology expo.

projects.title: SAE BAJA Racing Team
paragraphs: Lead day-to-day team operations, schedule design reviews for all student-engineered parts, manage technical subteams, and overhauled the sponsorship packet for corporate outreach.
Designed and manufactured the vehicle braking system and powertrain guarding in compliance with SAE safety standards.
Train new members in welding, plasma cutting, milling, turning, and tube bending to maintain strict vehicle assembly schedules.
projects.stack: Previously: Secretary of Reporting & Braking Lead, 04/2025 – 04/2026

projects.title: Autonomous Boat Design
paragraphs: Led a student engineering team through brainstorming, planning, and rapid prototyping of an autonomous boat, designing the hull and internal wiring architecture.
Used CFD and FEA to test and iterate 3D-printed hull and electronics housing designs, culminating in a full technical report and presentation.

contact.lede: Open to internships and entry-level roles in aerospace design engineering and CAD. Reach out any time.
